newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Four S.Korean companies to hold IPOs this week.
newsitem.headline: Four S.Korean companies to hold IPOs this week.

text.p: Four South Korean firms are scheduled to offer their shares for subscriptions on Thursday and Friday, their underwriters said on Wednesday.
Details of the four companies holding initial public offerings are as follows:
Hyundai Housing and Industrial Development Co, a home builder, is offering 6.2 million shares at 14,000 won per share. LG Securities is acting as the lead manager.
AUK Corp, a transistor maker, will offer 468,750 shares at 16,000 won each to be underwritten by Hyundai Securities.
Dong Yang Elevator Co is offering 600,000 shares at 22,000 won a share, and the lead underwriter is Dongsuh Securities.
Korea Electronic Terminal Co is offering 280,000 shares at 36,000 won each, to be underwritten by Seoul Securities.
The shares will start trading on the stock exchange in October, the underwriters said.
